tagline: Record keyboard workflows once. Replay them from Stream Deck.
description: Record short keyboard macros by performing them once. Macro Recorder Lite captures key down/up events, combinations and timing on Windows, then lets you assign the recording to a Stream Deck key and replay it without writing scripts. Great for keyboard shortcuts, hotkeys and simple automation. Mouse recording, long macros, loops and Macro Library are available in Pro.
release_notes: Record keyboard key-down/key-up events, shortcuts and timing.
Assign the latest recording to any Replay Macro key and edit event delays.
Includes a ready-to-use REC / STOP / PLAY starter profile.
Adds a global Stop action and Ctrl+Shift+F12 emergency playback stop.
privacy: Macro contents stay local on the Windows PC and are never uploaded to PackRat.
pro_url_policy: Do not populate until a verified direct Macro Recorder Pro Marketplace URL exists.
